matches.tactical_summary: Mexico absorbed early pressure from Czechia, who started aggressively, before asserting control in the second half. El Tri's clinical finishing and defensive solidity were key, allowing them to capitalize on opportunities and secure a comfortable win.

narrative: Mexico completed a perfect group stage campaign with a commanding 3-0 victory over Czechia, securing their spot in the Round of 32 as Group A winners. This result eliminated Czechia from the tournament, while South Africa advanced as group runners-up and South Korea awaits to see if their third-place finish is enough to progress.
